parsedVerdict.reasoning: src/business/core/Event.ts sits in the business layer, which is of kind domain. Its core behaviour fits that layer: remaining() and sell() hold the business rules for seat capacity and pricing. The problem is that the class is also a TypeORM persistence mapping. The class carries the @Entity() decorator and the id field carries @Column(), which tie the domain entity to an ORM table and column layout. That mapping is a persistence (infrastructure) job and belongs in src/persistence, for example as a separate ORM entity or mapper. This is a misplaced responsibility, not only an import-direction issue, because the decorators change what the class is responsible for at runtime.
